questions.stem: To integrate Investment Funding with PPM, what plugin must be activated?
questions.explanation: To integrate Investment Funding with PPM, the Investment Funding for PPM plugin (com.snc.investment_planning_pmo) must be activated. This plugin provides the bridge between Investment Funding and PPM applications. The base Investment Funding plugin, Financial Planning, and Rate Model are separate plugins that do not provide the PPM integration.

questions.stem: A customer needs to know what activity type is associated to time entries in the project so that they can capitalize build tasks. What is the best method to do this?

options.text: Leverage project time categories to classify the time.
Create a capital protect task flag.
Put all capital project tasks in one phase and report from those tasks.

questions.explanation: The best method to associate activity types to time entries for capitalizing build tasks is to leverage project time categories to classify the time. Time categories allow administrators to tag time entries with specific activity types (like Build, Test, Deploy), enabling accurate capitalization reporting. Custom flags, phase grouping, and incidents are less effective approaches.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the default schedule for the Project Management application?

options.text: Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 8:00am to noon and 1:00-5:00pm
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday. Includes the child schedule U.S. Holidays
Repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 9:00am to 5:00pm

questions.explanation: The default schedule for the Project Management application repeats every week on weekdays Monday through Friday from 8:00am to noon and 1:00-5:00pm (8-hour workday with a one-hour lunch break). This matches the standard PPM default schedule. Options without the noon break or with different hours are incorrect.

questions.stem: Demand managers can enhance a demand request by adding the following: (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Demand managers can enhance a demand request by adding Requirements (detailed needs specifications), Decisions (recorded choices and justifications), and Stakeholders (involved parties). Tasks and Expense lines are not standard demand enhancement options in the base system — they are project-level artifacts.

questions.stem: To provide more meaningful information to senior management, you can view the FTE value under which of the following reports?
questions.explanation: To provide meaningful FTE information to senior management, you can view the FTE value under the Committed Utilization report. This report shows resource utilization as a ratio of allocated vs capacity, which can be expressed in FTE terms. Resource Aggregate Reports show raw data, Functional Currency is financial, and Allocation Details show individual allocations.

questions.stem: Which option should be used if you want to select the resource rate on the resource plan?
questions.explanation: The Rate override option should be used if you want to select the resource rate directly on the resource plan. Rate override allows manual specification of the hourly rate, overriding any rate card or rate model values. Labor rate card uses predefined tables, Rate model uses criteria-based rates, and Planned cost is an output value.

questions.stem: Which of the following tasks can be performed when innovation Management is integrated with Universal Request? (Choose two.)

options.text: Transfer an idea to another department
Create a project from a universal request
Send a universal request to a demand manager for review
Create an idea from a universal request

questions.explanation: When Innovation Management is integrated with Universal Request, you can Transfer an idea to another department (moving ideas between business units) and Create an idea from a universal request (converting incoming requests into ideas for evaluation). Creating projects from universal requests and sending requests to demand managers are not features of this integration.

questions.stem: The RIDAC workflow can be modified by using which recommended feature?
questions.explanation: The RIDAC workflow can be modified using Flow Designer, which is the recommended tool. Flow Designer is ServiceNow's modern automation tool for creating and modifying workflows. While Workflow Editor (legacy) could also technically modify workflows, Flow Designer is the recommended approach. Service Catalog and Project Form are not workflow modification tools.

questions.stem: A project status report can be viewed from which of the following areas? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: A project status report can be viewed from the Program record (rolled up project health), Project workspace (project overview), Project status form (direct report access), and Project record (report related list). The Planning console shows the project schedule/Gantt chart, and the Portfolio workbench shows portfolio-level views — neither displays individual project status reports.

questions.stem: Which role is required to define custom schedules?
questions.explanation: The system admin (admin) role is required to define custom schedules. Schedule management is a platform-level function requiring administrative privileges. Resource managers, pps_resource users, and resource_users can use schedules but cannot create or modify schedule definitions — that requires the admin role.

questions.stem: As an administrator, what can you use to customize the PPM Mobile application?
questions.explanation: As an administrator, you can use Mobile Studio to customize the PPM Mobile application. Mobile Studio is ServiceNow's tool for configuring and customizing mobile application experiences, including the layout, navigation, and functionality of the PPM Mobile app. Now Platform App Engine and Now Mobile App are broader tools, and Service Catalog is unrelated to mobile customization.

questions.stem: What are the three default project template configuration records available in the Template Config module? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three default project template configuration records available in the Template Config module are Project subtask, Project task, and Project. These templates define the default fields and values copied when creating new records of each type. Portfolio task, Program task, Task, and Project template are not default template configuration records.

questions.stem: If a sub-project and parent project have different project currencies, this property should be set to true for cost roll-ups.
questions.explanation: If a sub-project and parent project have different project currencies, the property com.snc.project.multicurrency.rollup_if_different should be set to true for cost roll-ups. This enables the system to handle multi-currency cost aggregation between projects with different currencies, converting as needed for accurate financial reporting.

questions.stem: Can an it_project_manager convert a task to a milestone?

options.text: Yes, if the task is assigned to the project manager.
Yes, by right-clicking on the task in the Planning Console.
No, the PPS admin role is also required.
No, this can only be done by a system admin.

questions.explanation: Yes, an it_project_manager can convert a task to a milestone by right-clicking on the task in the Planning Console and selecting the conversion option. This is the same as Q67 — the Planning Console provides this context-menu action. It does not require admin or PPS admin roles, and the task does not need to be assigned to the project manager.

questions.stem: Transition, Mobilize, Prepare and Conduct are included in which stage of the Now Create methodology?
questions.explanation: Transition, Mobilize, Prepare, and Conduct are included in the Transition stage of the Now Create methodology. The Now Create methodology guides ServiceNow implementations through stages, and the Transition stage covers the activities needed to move from project delivery to operational support, including mobilization, preparation, and conducting the handover.
